title: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
abstract: arXiv:2611.18715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. translated_title: T2T技术报告：从视频教程大规模合成GUI智能体交互轨迹
translated_abstract: 训练通用GUI智能体需要大量由截图序列与带定位信息的UI动作配对组成的交互轨迹数据，然而通过人工演示收集此类数据成本高昂且难以规模化。尽管公开的软件教程视频包含丰富的操作演示，但其连续的像素流缺乏离散的动作边界、语义意图和精确的空间坐标，因此难以直接用于模型训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出了T2T（Tutorial-to-Trajectory），一个用于大规模合成GUI智能体轨迹的全自动化流水线。T2T覆盖桌面、网页和移动平台，能够将未标注的视频教程转换为结构化、可执行的交互轨迹。为保证轨迹质量，T2T结合了主动片段筛选、基于局部UI变化的关键帧识别、无快捷方式观察帧选择以及具有存在感知的定位等机制。
tldr: 提出全自动化流水线T2T，将未标注的视频教程大规模转化为覆盖桌面、网页与移动平台的结构化、可执行GUI智能体交互轨迹。
en_tdlr: T2T is a fully automated pipeline that synthesizes structured, executable GUI agent trajectories at scale from unannotated video tutorials across desktop, web, and mobile platforms.
